title: discern config document
description: The declarative config shape consumed by `discern init --config <file>` and by a preset's `preset.json`. Its capabilities/checks/scopes/ratchets are written into a project's .discern/config.toml via the comment-preserving editor. Every field is optional.

commandOrList.description: A single command, or a list of commands run in order.

$schema.description: Editor-only pointer to this schema; ignored by discern.

version.description: Document major version. Omit (assumed current) or use a matching major; this build understands version 2.

slug.description: Project slug: lowercase letters, digits and dashes, starting with a letter or digit.

brief.description: Free-text description of what the project is.

agents.description: Which agent instruction files to compile (e.g. claude_code, codex).

description.description: Preset metadata, shown when listing presets; ignored by `init --config`.

capabilities.description: [capabilities] fills — a known capability name mapped to a command (or a list). The gate stage is derived from the name. The set is closed; for custom work use `checks`.

checks.description: [checks.<name>] fills — custom gate work outside the known capability vocabulary.

stage.description: When the check runs in the gate.

scopes.description: [scopes.<name>] tables — a named region defined by `paths`, with optional attributes.

paths.description: The globs that define the scope.

neutral.description: true: changes here need no gate.

previewable.description: true: a person could see changes here.

gate.description: A command to run when this scope changed (the former side gate).

ratchets.description: [ratchets.<name>] tables. Coverage is just a conventional name.

metric.description: Metric name the run emits (default: the ratchet name).

direction.description: "up": limit is a floor; "down": limit is a ceiling. Default "up".

run.description: The command whose output emits the metric line: DISCERN_METRIC <metric> <number>.
